headline: Focus AI traffic on /backtest pages; cut zero-click economic calendar pages

findings.claim: AI reads many economic calendar pages but they get zero clicks, wasting AI attention
findings.so: Stop sending AI traffic to economic calendar pages with zero clicks

findings.claim: /backtest family pages have high AI reads and clicks and good account conversion
findings.so: Focus AI traffic on /backtest family pages to improve AI click-through and signups

findings.claim: AI accounts per week dropped from 30 to 22 despite stable AI clicks at 39/week
findings.so: Investigate and fix the drop in AI accounts despite stable AI clicks

findings.claim: Direct and /backtest-<market> landing pages lose many potential accounts at land → account stage
findings.so: Improve conversion on direct and /backtest-<market> landing pages to reduce account loss

findings.claim: ChatGPT signups have 12% replay rate, below Google signups at 22%, indicating lower quality
findings.so: Target AI traffic to pages with higher replay rates to improve quality

proposals.why: winner: 4.51 accounts, 6.77 clicks, 0.75 reads proven to convert well

knobs.why: current champion 0.15, challenger 0.2 under test with no verdict yet to improve AI click rate (rate0 0.00848)
